lanes.label: code written

lanes.label: calls to the RCD LLM service
lanes.note: a chunk records how many calls it made and when it ran, but no reply carries a time of its own, so each chunk's calls are spread evenly across its own span and counted in 15-minute steps: a rate, not one mark per call

lanes.label: jobs waiting on the RCD LLM service
lanes.note: the scoring jobs; their time is spent waiting on the RCD LLM service, whose GPU time this project never measures

lanes.label: jobs computing on the cluster
lanes.note: sampling, features, the fits, the tests, the figures and the tables

headline: 63 prompts set off 662 jobs, 58,409 calls to the RCD LLM service and 290 hours of machine time.
method: A job is the interval its own manifest states: `written` less `wall_seconds`. Where jobs of the same lane overlap, the lane draws the period they occupied between them rather than one bar per job.
A prompt is the timestamp on its SESSION_LOG.md heading, and a commit its commit date - instants, not durations.
A commit counts as an agent's where it carries a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer; the author of every commit in this repository is the owner.
The call rate is each score chunk's own call count spread evenly across the interval that chunk ran in, summed over chunks into 15-minute bins.
caveats: No archived response carries a wall-clock time of its own - only the seconds it took - so the calls are dated to the chunk that recorded them and spread evenly across it in 15-minute bins. The lane is a rate, not 58,409 placed events, and a wave's shape within a chunk is smoother than the truth.
Prompts and commits are marked as moments because that is all the record holds. Nothing here measures human time, and no duration is inferred from the gaps.

No rule in this workflow asks for a GPU - the Snakefile passes only memory, runtime and CPUs - so the jobs are split by what they waited on instead. The model service answered 58,409 calls on GPUs this project never meters; its jobs cost this cluster 0.6 h of CPU against 288 h of wall time.
Only surviving results are counted. Work that was rerun or rewound - arm D, the deleted archive - left no manifest behind and so appears nowhere.
